verdict.rationale: Subscription analytics is a fair question for a billing and invoicing product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows generic reports on customer payment patterns and an integration with Zoho Analytics, which is the bolted-on BI approach the story rejects. Nothing in the pack shows native MRR, churn, cohort retention or LTV metrics.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export
